independence: Reviewer did not author or edit any of these PNGs. Earlier graph composition authorship grants no image authority. Current goal bodies are context only; no graph approval here.

No arrow makes a new or charged battery. The scale places recovered material/leaf opposite energy and a closed residue container; it does not declare a universal winner.
rows.native: All captions are clear; labels and arrows are separate; closed objects and balance context are coherent.
rows.mobile360: Both source types, all three route arrows, material outputs and balance remain identifiable. Fachbetrieb/Energie/Reste are the smallest labels but are readable in the actual DPR1 360x203 screenshot; no essential text is cut.
rows.desktop680: All nine captions and route/balance details are readable at 680x383.
rows.safety: No opening, cutting, crushing, heating, household reaction, ordinary waste-bin route or handling instruction. The depicted collection box carries battery/accumulator silhouettes.
rows.wholeGoalFit: Supports discussion of both battery and accumulator disposal/recycling and environmental benefits/costs. It is a motivating symbolic overview rather than assessment evidence.

rows.spatialInspection: Ore cart -> enclosed processing building -> refined platinum -> named PEM device is coherent. H2 and O2 feed distinct blue sides; electrical output points outward. The Katalysator leader and circular target terminate on a single thick gold central layer between those sides. This location reads as a separator/membrane or solid platinum separator, with no separate membrane or thin catalytic face identified.
rows.native: All ten captions are readable. The precise central gold target is visible near x1330,y510 (native1672x941).
rows.mobile360: The same leader attaches to the central gold stripe near x286,y110; all captions are legible and the separator-like target remains the semantic problem.
rows.desktop680: Leader attachment to the central strip remains unmistakable near x541,y208.
rows.safety: Mine and factory are symbolic industrial settings without household extraction instructions.
rows.wholeGoalFit: Rare-metal extraction use/tradeoff cues fit the whole goal. The PEM pointer introduces a fixable wrong or ambiguous component relationship; calling the block abstract in author metadata does not remove its visible teaching claim.
rows.boundedCorrection: Change only the right-hand PEM block and its catalyst leader. Show a neutral central polymer membrane/space distinctly separate from two thin catalyst-bearing electrode faces, or use a clearly non-architectural device with a small separate Pt-catalyst callout. Point Katalysator to the thin Pt-bearing face/callout, never the central separating membrane or a thick solid Pt sheet. Retain H2/O2 input directions and electrical output; retain mining route, Pt example and land/water/energy cues. Reinspect corrected bytes at native360680; no correction to the other two images.

rows.spatialInspection: Top bauxite -> enclosed professional production -> aluminium ingot and lower scrap -> professional recovery -> same named material are grouped by a brace. A separate person and bottle lead to distinct longer-use and end-of-use return symbols. Arrows do not connect reuse to immediate disposal.
rows.native: All eight captions are readable; both outputs are named by one aluminium brace; reuse and return are visibly separate.
rows.mobile360: The top/bottom routes and qualitative energy labels remain readable. Länger nutzen/Getrennt zurückgeben are smallest but both two-line labels are readable at 360x203; no essential text is cropped.
rows.desktop680: All captions and route/reuse/return relations are readable at 680x383.
rows.safety: No learner melting, dismantling or process instructions. Return bin is a generic separate material-return cue; it does not purport to specify a local legal collection scheme.
rows.wholeGoalFit: Selected aluminium example supports resource conservation, energy saving and both consumption/use and eventual disposal choices. Factory icons omit intermediate industrial steps rather than inventing a bauxite-melting mechanism.
rows.qualitativeEnergyBoundary: Three lightning symbols versus one are pictorial more/less cues accompanied by explicit words; there is no numerical ratio, scale, energy unit or percentage. KEEP applies to a qualitative reading only. Do not infer or teach 3:1, 67% or any other number from the icons. The lower route visibly still consumes energy.
